entries.body: The same module-scope contract leakage category appears across distinct backbones. A language-aware detector can flag top-level expressions that load names bound only as function parameters; keep it experimental until tested against framework-injected globals.

VETOED by the user (2026-08-31): both supporting cells are [redacted-id] variants. Governance ruling recorded: same-family model variants (including different sizes, e.g. Qwen2.5-32B vs 7B) do NOT count as distinct models for the cross-model promotion gate. Cluster remains active; eligible again if a non-Qwen model independently supports it.
